scope: CPU numerical MemoryCell research; not a pretrained language model or production integration
encoding: shared frozen hash encoder; model reads typed canonical keys; free-text routing reported separately
typed_readout_scope: written-key recall; changing question text does not create a new effective model input

composition_profile.scaffold: supplied episodic-to-semantic-to-procedural chain; fixed shared slot vocabulary

growth_profile.selection: sort keys within domain; even indices selection, odd indices hidden test; all keys may be written, but selection/test readout keys are disjoint

read_modes.parameter_only: fresh process receives only checked parameter artifacts and query keys; no events, targets, replay, raw text or retained hidden state
read_modes.hybrid_baseline: exact and lexical retrieval may read source events; all payload and index bytes counted

budget_rule: count model tensors, routing tensors, manifests and source payload separately; use a single-cell comparator with at least the multi-cell numerical storage budget and report integer-rank rounding; also report actual training work and wall time

stage_criteria.single: fresh-process exact accuracy >= 0.95 on primary load for every registered seed; publish all capacity and distortion measurements regardless of outcome
stage_criteria.multi: actual routed accuracy exceeds same-budget single by >= 0.02 and the exploratory seed-cluster 95% interval excludes zero; report oracle gap
stage_criteria.graph: typed composition exceeds no-edge and valid shuffled-edge ablations; disclose fixed type/program scaffold and include exact chained retrieval
stage_criteria.maintenance: new/corrected accuracy >= 0.95; old retention regression <= 0.02; revoked lineage cannot serve; clean retrain excludes removed records
stage_criteria.growth: selected split or merge outperforms same-budget fixed structure on hidden queries and measured total lifecycle cost; selection never reads test targets
stage_criteria.transfer: frozen writer/reader settings evaluated on independent seeds, domains and pinned real-source facts; broad transfer remains unqualified without independent real task streams

qualification_aggregation: single, graph, maintenance and growth require their criterion on every registered primary seed; multi uses the preregistered paired seed-cluster comparison; transfer never establishes broad generality from these diagnostics alone
statistics: paired differences clustered by independent seed or root episode, never by paraphrase; small-seed intervals are exploratory, not future-calendar qualification
negative_results: retain failed comparisons; no hyperparameter search on final hidden-query scores; no relabeling mechanism tests as efficacy
